name: Large diff review guard
summary: Require a smaller staged change when a commit exceeds bounded reviewability thresholds.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for git commit that measures the file count, text additions and deletions, and binary size the commit will take (the staged snapshot, or an upper bound against HEAD when the command stages or commits working-tree content), then blocks changes above explicit fixed reviewability limits.
risk_reason: This automatic gate requires a smaller staged change when a commit exceeds bounded reviewability thresholds; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not split, edit, stage, unstage, commit, summarize, review, or approve the change.
It does not claim that a small diff is correct or that a large diff is necessarily unsafe.
It does not count unstaged work that the commit will not take, or generated impact outside the commit.
It does not accept repository configuration, commit flags, or prompt text as a bypass.

entrypoints.purpose: Measure the staged Git change and reject commits that exceed deterministic reviewability budgets.

operational.latency_reason: To require a smaller staged change when a commit exceeds bounded reviewability thresholds, the entrypoint may run a bounded local subprocess before returning.
